concerns: config_schema 的 default 不再由前端预填：旧扁平 normalizePluginConfigSchema 会用 field.default 初始化缺失字段，合成路径与 ui_schema 路径一致改为仅从 config 初始化，后端也未应用 config-schema default，属行为变更。
readOnly 属性渲染为 read_only 禁用但值仍随 config 回写，后端 rejectReadOnlyConfigValue 会拒绝；此为 ui_schema 声明式路径已有的既有问题，不在本任务范围。
execution.summary: 在 pluginSecurity.js 新增 schemaToUIComponents(schema)，无 ui_schema 时从合法 config_schema 递归合成宿主可渲染的声明式组件树：嵌套 object→section（子组件持完整 pointer 绑定），array→array（对象项子组件持相对绑定、标量项无子组件），writeOnly→secret，string enum→select，number/integer→number（minimum/maximum/multipleOf→step），string 约束→min_length/max_length/pattern，boolean→toggle，readOnly→read_only；$ref、contentMediaType:text/html 与不支持类型被过滤。新增 stripWriteOnlyConfigValues(schema,config) 在渲染前剥离 writeOnly 明文，确保秘密值绝不回写提交载荷。移除扁平 normalizePluginConfigSchema 及 safeDefault/allowedSchemaTypes 辅助（无残留引用）。PluginConfigForm.vue 改为从 config_schema 合成声明式 document 并委派 PluginDeclarativeUI 渲染，秘密保留/轮换/清除提交语义不变（留空省略、输入值进 secret_replacements[pointer]、清除为 null、秘密排除出 config）。vitest 指定两文件 9 用例全绿，components/plugins+api 目录 80 用例全绿。

findings: P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/api/pluginSecurity.js:164 | root cause: synthesizeComponent's switch default branch returns [] instead of a read-only fallback, so fields whose type the synthesizer does not handle — notably "null", which validateSchemaNode (validator.go:1564) accepts, and nodes with no "type" — are silently dropped from the synthesized component tree | refs: 02-technical-solution.md §关键失败行为 "未知类型→只读文本展示而非静默丢弃"; schemaToUIComponents default:return [] | impact: a legal config_schema containing a null/unknown-typed field renders no control for it, so R2 "任意合法 config_schema 可完整编辑保存" is not fully met (value round-trips because the renderer model is seeded from config, but the field is invisible and cannot be edited) | minimal fix: synthesize an unhandled type into a read_only notice/text component bound to the pointer instead of returning []

P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/components/plugins/PluginConfigForm.vue:21 | root cause: replacing normalizePluginConfigSchema's initialize() removed default seeding (safeDefault prefill plus boolean→false), and the new config computed only strips writeOnly; the backend (config.go ValidateConfig) also never applies config_schema "default" | refs: removed safeDefault/allowedSchemaTypes in pluginSecurity.js; PluginConfigForm.vue config computed | impact: config_schema "default" values and boolean false-initialization are no longer applied anywhere in the system, so a fresh config with declared defaults renders empty and required-with-default fields demand manual entry before a save can succeed | minimal fix: seed missing model fields from schema "default" (and boolean false) before render, or apply defaults server-side during config preparation

P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/api/pluginSecurity.js:134 | root cause: readOnly fields are annotated read_only (disabled) but their values remain in the renderer model and are emitted in the submit config; stripWriteOnlyConfigValues removes only writeOnly, not readOnly | refs: validator.go rejectReadOnlyConfigValue rejects any submitted readOnly value; PluginDeclarativeUI.vue submit clones the full model | impact: a config_schema with a readOnly field cannot be saved at all (configure is always rejected), violating "任意合法 config_schema 可完整编辑保存"; pre-existing in the ui_schema declarative path and flagged by the worker as out-of-scope, but now also reachable through the synthesis path this task adds | minimal fix: strip readOnly values from the submit payload (exclude readOnly fields from config, mirroring the writeOnly strip)

P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/api/pluginSecurity.js:164 | root cause: synthesizeComponent 的 switch default 分支返回 []，未对未处理类型合成只读回退组件；后端 validateSchemaNode (validator.go:1564) 接受 type "null"，且无 "type" 键的属性亦通过校验，因此这类合法 config_schema 属性被静默丢弃 | refs: 02-technical-solution.md §关键失败行为 "未知类型→只读文本展示而非静默丢弃"; schemaToUIComponents default:return [] | impact: R2 "任意合法 config_schema 可完整编辑保存" 未完全满足——null/无类型字段不渲染任何控件，不可见不可编辑（值因渲染模型以 config 为种子仍回写） | minimal fix: 将未处理/无类型字段合成为绑定其 pointer 的 read_only notice/text 组件，而非返回 []

P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/components/plugins/PluginConfigForm.vue:21 | root cause: 移除 normalizePluginConfigSchema 的 initialize() 丢掉了 default 预填（safeDefault 预填 + boolean→false），新的 config computed 仅剥离 writeOnly；后端 ValidateConfig (config.go) 也从不应用 config_schema "default" | refs: pluginSecurity.js 中删除的 safeDefault/allowedSchemaTypes; PluginConfigForm.vue config computed | impact: config_schema "default" 值与 boolean 的 false 初始化在全系统不再被应用，声明了默认值的全新配置渲染为空，带 default 的必填字段需手动填写才能保存 | minimal fix: 渲染前用 schema "default"（及 boolean false）种子化缺失的 model 字段，或在服务端配置准备阶段应用默认值

P2[advisory]: panel/frontend/src/api/pluginSecurity.js:134 | root cause: readOnly 字段被标注 read_only（禁用）但其值仍留在渲染模型并随提交 config 输出；stripWriteOnlyConfigValues 只剥离 writeOnly 不剥离 readOnly | refs: validator.go rejectReadOnlyConfigValue 拒绝任何提交的 readOnly 值（service/plugins.go:1179 调用）；PluginDeclarativeUI.vue submit 克隆完整 model | impact: 含 readOnly 字段的 config_schema 完全无法保存（configure 恒被拒绝），违反 "任意合法 config_schema 可完整编辑保存"；此问题在 ui_schema 声明式路径已存在、被 worker 标注为范围外，但本任务新增的合成路径同样可达 | minimal fix: 从提交载荷剥离 readOnly 值（从 config 排除 readOnly 字段，镜像 writeOnly 剥离）

P3: panel/frontend/src/api/pluginSecurity.js:147 | root cause: number/integer 的 enum 未参与合成——synthesizeComponent 仅对 string enum 映射为 select，且 schemaEnumOptions (pluginSecurity.js:119) 过滤为 typeof item === 'string'，因此合法的 number/integer 属性带 enum 时被渲染为自由数字输入，其允许值被丢弃 | refs: 旧 normalizePluginConfigSchema 将数字 enum 渲染为 <select>（enum 过滤含 number/boolean）；validator.go 允许任意类型的 enum | impact: number/integer 字段的 enum 允许值不再展示、也不在前端约束，用户可输入越界值、仅由后端拒绝；对 "保留约束关键字" 与 R2 构成轻微 UX 回归 | minimal fix: 将 number/integer enum 合成为带数字选项的 select，或至少将 enum 作为约束提示展示
